summary: Iteration 91 - Verified NEW feature: YEAR is now shown together with the check date on ALL bank reconciliation checks (auto-synced outstanding + collection + prior-year) in the editor, saved payload, preview print, edit round-trip. Backend pytest (3/3) + Playwright UI (7/7 key assertions) PASS. Month filter regression re-verified: يناير 2026 shows 1 outstanding row; فبراير 2026 shows 2 (Jan+Feb). Excel export button present. All test data cleaned up.

issues: outstanding-print table header still reads 'التاريخ يوم/شهر' but the cell now renders day/month/YEAR (e.g. 20/01/2026). Consider updating the header to 'التاريخ يوم/شهر/سنة' or 'التاريخ'. Not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Update outstanding/collection print table header text to reflect the new day/month/year format (currently says 'التاريخ يوم/شهر').
critical_code_review_comments: BankReconciliationPage.jsx (871 lines) is growing; consider extracting ChecksTable/CheckEditor and date helpers into shared utils.

formatCheckDateDisplay depends on row.year OR extractYearFromCheckDate(check_date); works well because backend returns ISO dates. For memos saved by an older client that omitted year, extractYearFromCheckDate() correctly recovers the year from the stored datetime.
ChecksTable header label ('التاريخ يوم/شهر') is now inconsistent with the day/month/year value shown - minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 expense-check records (Jan/Feb 2026), 1 revenue-check record (Jan 2026), 1 reconciliation memo. All cleaned up via DELETE at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key evidence from this run: (a) editor input outstanding-check-0-date-input shows '20/01/2026' for a Jan-2026 expense-check; collection input shows '22/01/2026'. (b) Backend memo persists outstanding_checks[0].year=2026 and prior_year_outstanding_checks[0].year=2024; PUT preserves year. (c) Preview outstanding-print-row-0-date renders Arabic-Indic '٢٠/٠١/٢٠٢٦'. (d) Note: prior-year rows are appended to the outstanding-print table (see line 831 BankReconciliationPage.jsx) - so prior-year row appears at index 1, NOT under a separate 'prior-year-outstanding-print-row-*' testId. (e) Month filter works: يناير→1 row, فبراير→2 rows. (f) Delete modal + Excel export already verified in iteration_90 and remain intact.
rca of the issue: Feature works end-to-end. Frontend rowsFromExpenseChecks/rowsFromRevenueChecks now stamp year = yearFromSourceDate(issued_at/dated) on each auto-synced row; formatCheckDateDisplay concatenates dd/mm with /year. cleanChecks includes year in POST/PUT payloads; ReconciliationCheck.year Optional[int] round-trips. fillFormFromReconciliation restores year on edit, so re-saving does not overwrite the historical year.
